  var switchRole = function switchRole(roleKey) {

  // M├ëTRICAS DO DIA
  var todaysAppointments = useMemo(function () {
    return appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.day === 'Seg' && (a.weekId === 0 || a.weekId === undefined);
    });
  }, [appointments]);
  var completedToday = todaysAppointments.filter(function (a) {
    return a.status === 'concluido';
  });

    return a.status === 'em_atendimento';

    return a.status === 'aguardando';
  });
  var scheduledToday = todaysAppointments.filter(function (a) {
    return a.status === 'agendado';

    return acc + (a.total || a.price);

  var revenueBalcao = counterSales.reduce(function (acc, s) {
    return acc + s.total;

  var totalRevenueToday = revenueServices + revenueBalcao;

  // ATUALIZA├ç├âO DE ESTOQUE
  var updateStock = function updateStock(id, delta) {
    setProducts(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (item) {
        return item.id === id ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, item), {}, {
          stock: Math.max(0, item.stock + delta)
        }) : item;
      });
    });
  };

  // ATUALIZA├ç├âO DE STATUS DE AGENDAMENTO
  var changeAppointmentStatus = function changeAppointmentStatus(id, newStatus) {
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (a) {
        return a.id === id ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, a), {}, {
          status: newStatus
        }) : a;
      });
    });
  };

  // REMOVER AGENDAMENTO
  var deleteAppointment = function deleteAppointment(id) {
    if (confirm('Deseja realmente remover este agendamento?')) {
      setAppointments(function (prev) {
        return prev.filter(function (a) {
          return a.id !== id;
        });
      });
    }
  };

  // ABRIR MODAL DE EDI├ç├âO
  var openEditAppointment = function openEditAppointment(appt) {
    setEditingAppt(_objectSpread({}, appt));
    setIsEditApptModalOpen(true);
  };

  // SALVAR EDI├ç├âO DO AGENDAMENTO
  var handleSaveEditedAppt = function handleSaveEditedAppt(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (a) {
        return a.id === editingAppt.id ? editingAppt : a;
      });
    });
    setIsEditApptModalOpen(false);
  };

  // CRIAR NOVO AGENDAMENTO
  var handleCreateBooking = function handleCreateBooking(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!bookingForm.client || !bookingForm.phone) {
      alert('Por favor preencha nome e WhatsApp.');
      return;
    }
    var srv = services.find(function (s) {
      return s.id === bookingForm.serviceId;
    }) || services[0];
    var brb = barbers.find(function (b) {
      return b.barberKey === bookingForm.barberKey;
    }) || barbers[0];
    var newAppt = {
      id: Date.now(),
      weekId: currentWeek.id,
      day: bookingForm.day,
      date: bookingForm.day === 'Seg' ? '08/09' : bookingForm.day === 'Ter' ? '09/09' : '10/09',
      dayNum: bookingForm.day === 'Seg' ? 8 : bookingForm.day === 'Ter' ? 9 : 10,
      client: bookingForm.client,
      phone: bookingForm.phone,
      service: srv.name,
      barber: brb.name,
      time: bookingForm.time,
      status: 'agendado',
      price: srv.price,
      items: [{
        name: srv.name,
        price: srv.price
      }],
      total: srv.price,
      paymentMethod: '',
      notes: bookingForm.notes || 'Agendamento registrado no sistema.'
    };
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return [newAppt].concat(_toConsumableArray(prev));
    });
    setIsBookingModalOpen(false);
    setBookingForm({
      client: '',
      phone: '',
      serviceId: 's1',
      barberKey: 'luis',
      day: 'Seg',
      time: '14:00',
      notes: ''
    });
  };

  // CHECKOUT / FECHAMENTO DE COMANDA
  var openCheckout = function openCheckout(appt) {
    setCheckoutAppt(_objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, appt), {}, {
      items: _toConsumableArray(appt.items)
    }));
    setIsCheckoutModalOpen(true);
  };
  var addItemToCheckout = function addItemToCheckout(product) {
    if (!checkoutAppt || !product) return;
    if (product.price > 0 && product.stock <= 0) {
      alert('Item sem estoque!');
      return;
    }
    updateStock(product.id, -1);
    setCheckoutAppt(function (prev) {
      return _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, prev), {}, {
        items: [].concat(_toConsumableArray(prev.items), [{
          name: product.name,
          price: product.price
        }]),
        total: prev.total + product.price
      });
    });
  };
  var handleConfirmCheckout = function handleConfirmCheckout() {
    if (!checkoutAppt) return;
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (a) {
        return a.id === checkoutAppt.id ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, a), {}, {
          status: 'concluido',
          items: checkoutAppt.items,
          total: checkoutAppt.total,
          paymentMethod: selectedPayment
        }) : a;
      });
    });
    setIsCheckoutModalOpen(false);
    setCheckoutAppt(null);
  };

  // VENDA AVULSA DE BALC├âO
  var handleQuickSale = function handleQuickSale(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!quickSaleProduct) return;
    var total = quickSaleProduct.price * quickSaleQty;
    updateStock(quickSaleProduct.id, -quickSaleQty);
    setCounterSales(function (prev) {
      return [{
        id: Date.now(),
        item: quickSaleProduct.name,
        category: quickSaleProduct.category,
        qty: quickSaleQty,
        total: total,
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', {
          hour: '2-digit',
          minute: '2-digit'
        }),
        paymentMethod: quickSalePayment
      }].concat(_toConsumableArray(prev));
    });
    setIsQuickSaleModalOpen(false);
  };

    setNewProductForm({
      name: '',
      category: 'Bar',
      price: 15,
      stock: 20,
      minStock: 5,
      type: 'Bebida'
    });
  };

  var toggleBarberDay = function toggleBarberDay(day) {

        return d !== day;
      }));

      setBarberEditActiveDays([].concat(_toConsumableArray(barberEditActiveDays), [day]));
    }
  };

    // =========================================================================
    // COMPONENTE PRINCIPAL
    // =========================================================================
    function ValverdsApp() {
      // NAVEGA├ç├âO E VIS├âO
      const [currentView, setCurrentView] = useState('site'); // 'site' | 'panel' | 'login'
      const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState('home');

      // PERFIL ATIVO (RBAC HIER├üRQUICO)
      const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState({
        name: 'Luis Valverde',
        email: 'luis@valverds.com',
        role: 'dono', // 'dono' | 'barbeiro' | 'recepcao' | 'cliente'
        barberKey: 'luis',
        title: 'Propriet├írio & Mestre Barbeiro',
        avatar: 'luis_valverde.jpg'
      });

      // ABAS GERENCIAIS
      const [managementTab, setManagementTab] = useState('agenda'); 
      // Op├º├Áes: 'agenda' | 'fila' | 'produtos' | 'financeiro' | 'escalas' | 'equipe'
      
      // ABAS DO BARBEIRO
      const [barberTab, setBarberTab] = useState('minha_agenda'); // 'minha_agenda' | 'meus_ganhos' | 'minha_escala'
      const [barberCalendarMode, setBarberCalendarMode] = useState('semanal'); // 'semanal' | 'mensal' | 'comparativo' | 'diaria'
      
      // ABAS DO CLIENTE
      const [clientTab, setClientTab] = useState('proximo'); // 'proximo' | 'calendario' | 'fidelidade' | 'historico' | 'estilo' | 'perfil'
      const [clientCalendarView, setClientCalendarView] = useState('semana');

      // CONTROLE DE SEMANAS
      const [selectedWeekIndex, setSelectedWeekIndex] = useState(1); // 1 = Semana Atual
      const [selectedWeekDay, setSelectedWeekDay] = useState('Seg');
      const [selectedMonthDay, setSelectedMonthDay] = useState(8);

      // ESTADO DOS DADOS VIVOS
      const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState(INITIAL_APPOINTMENTS);
      const [products, setProducts] = useState(INITIAL_PRODUCTS);
      const [services, setServices] = useState(INITIAL_SERVICES);
      const [barbers, setBarbers] = useState(INITIAL_BARBERS);
      const [shopHours, setShopHours] = useState(INITIAL_SHOP_HOURS);
      const [barberSchedules, setBarberSchedules] = useState(INITIAL_BARBER_SCHEDULES);
      const [clientProfile, setClientProfile] = useState(INITIAL_CLIENT_PROFILE);

      // ESTADO DO EDITOR DE ESCALA PELO BARBEIRO
      const [barberEditStartTime, setBarberEditStartTime] = useState('10:00');
      const [barberEditEndTime, setBarberEditEndTime] = useState('19:00');
      const [barberEditLunchBreak, setBarberEditLunchBreak] = useState('13:00 ├ás 14:00');
      const [barberEditActiveDays, setBarberEditActiveDays] = useState(['Ter', 'Qua', 'Qui', 'Sex', 'S├íb']);
      const [scheduleSavedToast, setScheduleSavedToast] = useState(false);

      // MODAIS DE A├ç├âO
      const [isBookingModalOpen, setIsBookingModalOpen] = useState(false);
      const [isEditApptModalOpen, setIsEditApptModalOpen] = useState(false);
      const [editingAppt, setEditingAppt] = useState(null);
      
      const [isCheckoutModalOpen, setIsCheckoutModalOpen] = useState(false);
      const [checkoutAppt, setCheckoutAppt] = useState(null);
      const [selectedPayment, setSelectedPayment] = useState('PIX');
      const [additionalItemId, setAdditionalItemId] = useState('');

      const [isQuickSaleModalOpen, setIsQuickSaleModalOpen] = useState(false);
      const [quickSaleProduct, setQuickSaleProduct] = useState(INITIAL_PRODUCTS[0]);
      const [quickSaleQty, setQuickSaleQty] = useState(1);
      const [quickSalePayment, setQuickSalePayment] = useState('PIX');

      const [isNewProductModalOpen, setIsNewProductModalOpen] = useState(false);
      const [newProductForm, setNewProductForm] = useState({ name: '', category: 'Bar', price: 15, stock: 20, minStock: 5, type: 'Bebida' });

      // FORMUL├üRIO DE NOVO AGENDAMENTO
      const [bookingForm, setBookingForm] = useState({
        client: '',
        phone: '',
        serviceId: 's1',
        barberKey: 'luis',
        day: 'Seg',
        time: '14:00',
        notes: ''
      });

      // VENDAS AVULSAS REGISTRADAS NO BALCAO
      const [counterSales, setCounterSales] = useState([
        { id: 901, item: 'Pomada Modeladora Matte Valverd\'s (150g)', category: 'Produtos', qty: 1, total: 45, time: '10:15', paymentMethod: 'PIX' },
        { id: 902, item: 'Cerveja IPA Artesanal Valverd\'s (500ml)', category: 'Bar', qty: 2, total: 40, time: '11:20', paymentMethod: 'CART├âO' }
      ]);

      const [currentSlide, setCurrentSlide] = useState(0);
      const nextSlide = () => setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % GALLERY_SLIDES.length);
      const prevSlide = () => setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + GALLERY_SLIDES.length) % GALLERY_SLIDES.length);

      const currentWeek = WEEKS_DATA[selectedWeekIndex] || WEEKS_DATA[1];

      // TROCA R├üPIDA DE PERFIL (RBAC EXECUTIVO)
      const switchRole = (roleKey) => {
        if (roleKey === 'dono') {
          setCurrentUser({
            name: 'Luis Valverde',
            email: 'luis@valverds.com',
            role: 'dono',
            barberKey: 'luis',
            title: 'Propriet├írio & Mestre Barbeiro',
            avatar: 'luis_valverde.jpg'
          });
          setCurrentView('panel');
          setManagementTab('agenda');
        } else if (roleKey === 'barbeiro') {
          setCurrentUser({
            name: 'Yago Barber',
            email: 'yago@valverds.com',
            role: 'barbeiro',
            barberKey: 'yago',
            title: 'Especialista em Fade & Estilo',
            avatar: 'yago_barber.png'
          });
          const yagoSched = barberSchedules.find(b => b.id === 'yago') || INITIAL_BARBER_SCHEDULES[1];
          setBarberEditStartTime(yagoSched.startTime);
          setBarberEditEndTime(yagoSched.endTime);
          setBarberEditLunchBreak(yagoSched.lunchBreak);
          setBarberEditActiveDays(yagoSched.activeDays);
          setCurrentView('panel');
          setBarberTab('minha_agenda');
        } else if (roleKey === 'recepcao') {
          setCurrentUser({
            name: 'Recep├º├úo Valverd\'s',
            email: 'recepcao@valverds.com',
            role: 'recepcao',
            barberKey: 'recepcao',
            title: 'Gerente de Recep├º├úo & Caixa',
            avatar: 'logo_valverds_clean.png'
          });
          setCurrentView('panel');
          setManagementTab('agenda');
        } else if (roleKey === 'cliente') {
          setCurrentUser({
            name: clientProfile.name,
            email: clientProfile.email,
            role: 'cliente',
            barberKey: 'cliente',
            title: clientProfile.tier,
            avatar: 'logo_valverds_clean.png'
          });
          setCurrentView('panel');
          setClientTab('proximo');
        }
      };

      // M├ëTRICAS DO DIA
      const todaysAppointments = useMemo(() => {
        return appointments.filter(a => a.day === 'Seg' && (a.weekId === 0 || a.weekId === undefined));
      }, [appointments]);

      const completedToday = todaysAppointments.filter(a => a.status === 'concluido');
      const inChairToday = todaysAppointments.filter(a => a.status === 'em_atendimento');
      const waitingToday = todaysAppointments.filter(a => a.status === 'aguardando');
      const scheduledToday = todaysAppointments.filter(a => a.status === 'agendado');

      const revenueServices = completedToday.reduce((acc, a) => acc + (a.total || a.price), 0);
      const revenueBalcao = counterSales.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.total, 0);
      const totalRevenueToday = revenueServices + revenueBalcao;

      // M├ëTRICAS DO BARBEIRO
      const currentBarberName = currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' ? currentUser.name : (currentUser.role === 'dono' ? 'Luis Valverde' : '');
      const myAllAppointments = useMemo(() => appointments.filter(a => a.barber === currentBarberName), [appointments, currentBarberName]);
      const myWeekAppointments = useMemo(() => myAllAppointments.filter(a => a.weekId === currentWeek.id || (currentWeek.id === 0 && a.weekId === undefined)), [myAllAppointments, currentWeek]);
      const myTodaysAppointments = useMemo(() => myAllAppointments.filter(a => a.day === 'Seg' && (a.weekId === 0 || a.weekId === undefined)), [myAllAppointments]);
      const myCompletedToday = myTodaysAppointments.filter(a => a.status === 'concluido');
      const myRevenueToday = myCompletedToday.reduce((acc, a) => acc + a.price, 0);
      const myCommissionRate = currentUser.name.includes('Luis') ? 0.60 : 0.50;
      const myCommissionToday = myRevenueToday * myCommissionRate;

      // ATUALIZA├ç├âO DE ESTOQUE
      const updateStock = (id, delta) => {
        setProducts(prev => prev.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, stock: Math.max(0, item.stock + delta) } : item));
      };

      // ATUALIZA├ç├âO DE STATUS DE AGENDAMENTO
      const changeAppointmentStatus = (id, newStatus) => {
        setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === id ? { ...a, status: newStatus } : a));
      };

      // REMOVER AGENDAMENTO
      const deleteAppointment = (id) => {
        if (confirm('Deseja realmente remover este agendamento?')) {
          setAppointments(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== id));
        }
      };

      // ABRIR MODAL DE EDI├ç├âO
      const openEditAppointment = (appt) => {
        setEditingAppt({ ...appt });
        setIsEditApptModalOpen(true);
      };

      // SALVAR EDI├ç├âO DO AGENDAMENTO
      const handleSaveEditedAppt = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === editingAppt.id ? editingAppt : a));
        setIsEditApptModalOpen(false);
      };

      // CRIAR NOVO AGENDAMENTO
      const handleCreateBooking = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!bookingForm.client || !bookingForm.phone) {
          alert('Por favor preencha nome e WhatsApp.');
          return;
        }

        const srv = services.find(s => s.id === bookingForm.serviceId) || services[0];
        const brb = barbers.find(b => b.barberKey === bookingForm.barberKey) || barbers[0];

        const newAppt = {
          id: Date.now(),
          weekId: currentWeek.id,
          day: bookingForm.day,
          date: bookingForm.day === 'Seg' ? '08/09' : bookingForm.day === 'Ter' ? '09/09' : '10/09',
          dayNum: bookingForm.day === 'Seg' ? 8 : bookingForm.day === 'Ter' ? 9 : 10,
          client: bookingForm.client,
          phone: bookingForm.phone,
          service: srv.name,
          barber: brb.name,
          time: bookingForm.time,
          status: 'agendado',
          price: srv.price,
          items: [{ name: srv.name, price: srv.price }],
          total: srv.price,
          paymentMethod: '',
          notes: bookingForm.notes || 'Agendamento registrado no sistema.'
        };

        setAppointments(prev => [newAppt, ...prev]);
        setIsBookingModalOpen(false);
        setBookingForm({ client: '', phone: '', serviceId: 's1', barberKey: 'luis', day: 'Seg', time: '14:00', notes: '' });
      };

      // CHECKOUT / FECHAMENTO DE COMANDA
      const openCheckout = (appt) => {
        setCheckoutAppt({ ...appt, items: [...appt.items] });
        setIsCheckoutModalOpen(true);
      };

      const addItemToCheckout = (product) => {
        if (!checkoutAppt || !product) return;
        if (product.price > 0 && product.stock <= 0) {
          alert('Item sem estoque!');
          return;
        }
        updateStock(product.id, -1);
        setCheckoutAppt(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          items: [...prev.items, { name: product.name, price: product.price }],
          total: prev.total + product.price
        }));
      };

      const handleConfirmCheckout = () => {
        if (!checkoutAppt) return;
        setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === checkoutAppt.id ? {
          ...a,
          status: 'concluido',
          items: checkoutAppt.items,
          total: checkoutAppt.total,
          paymentMethod: selectedPayment
        } : a));
        setIsCheckoutModalOpen(false);
        setCheckoutAppt(null);
      };

      // VENDA AVULSA DE BALC├âO
      const handleQuickSale = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!quickSaleProduct) return;
        const total = quickSaleProduct.price * quickSaleQty;
        updateStock(quickSaleProduct.id, -quickSaleQty);
        setCounterSales(prev => [
          {
            id: Date.now(),
            item: quickSaleProduct.name,
            category: quickSaleProduct.category,
            qty: quickSaleQty,
            total,
            time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
            paymentMethod: quickSalePayment
          },
          ...prev
        ]);
        setIsQuickSaleModalOpen(false);
      };

      // ADICIONAR NOVO PRODUTO AO ESTOQUE
      const handleAddNewProduct = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const newP = {
          id: 'p' + Date.now(),
          name: newProductForm.name,
          category: newProductForm.category,
          price: parseFloat(newProductForm.price),
          stock: parseInt(newProductForm.stock),
          minStock: parseInt(newProductForm.minStock),
          type: newProductForm.type
        };
        setProducts(prev => [...prev, newP]);
        setIsNewProductModalOpen(false);
        setNewProductForm({ name: '', category: 'Bar', price: 15, stock: 20, minStock: 5, type: 'Bebida' });
      };

      // SALVAR ESCALA DO BARBEIRO
      const handleSaveBarberSchedule = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const currentBarberId = currentUser.barberKey || 'yago';
        setBarberSchedules(prev => prev.map(b => b.id === currentBarberId ? {
          ...b,
          startTime: barberEditStartTime,
          endTime: barberEditEndTime,
          lunchBreak: barberEditLunchBreak,
          activeDays: barberEditActiveDays,
          workDaysDesc: `${barberEditActiveDays.join(', ')} (${barberEditStartTime} ├ás ${barberEditEndTime})`
        } : b));
        setScheduleSavedToast(true);
        setTimeout(() => setScheduleSavedToast(false), 4000);
      };

      const toggleBarberDay = (day) => {
        if (barberEditActiveDays.includes(day)) {
          setBarberEditActiveDays(barberEditActiveDays.filter(d => d !== day));
        } else {
          setBarberEditActiveDays([...barberEditActiveDays, day]);
        }
      };

      // COMPONENTE: BADGE STATUS APPLE
      const StatusBadge = ({ status }) => {
        const styles = {
          concluido: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200/60',
          em_atendimento: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200/60',
          aguardando: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200/60',
          agendado: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border-gray-200'
        };
        const labels = {
          concluido: 'Conclu├¡do',
          em_atendimento: 'Na Cadeira',
          aguardando: 'No Lounge',
          agendado: 'Agendado'
        };
        return (
          <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium border ${styles[status] || styles.agendado}`}>
            <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full mr-1.5 ${status === 'concluido' ? 'bg-emerald-500' : status === 'em_atendimento' ? 'bg-blue-500' : status === 'aguardando' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-gray-400'}`}></span>
            {labels[status] || status}
          </span>
        );
      };

      // COMPONENTE: SWITCHER FLUTUANTE DE PERFIS DEMO (APPLE DOCK STYLE)
      const FloatingDemoSwitcher = () => (
        <div className="fixed bottom-5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 glass-apple border border-white/80 shadow-apple-lg rounded-full px-3 py-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all hover:scale-105">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-apple-subtext uppercase tracking-wider pl-2 pr-1 hidden sm:inline">
            Modo Demo:
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={() => switchRole('dono')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all ${currentUser.role === 'dono' && currentView === 'panel' ? 'bg-black text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-apple-subtext hover:text-black hover:bg-black/5'}`}
          >
            ­ƒææ Dono
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => switchRole('barbeiro')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all ${currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' && currentView === 'panel' ? 'bg-black text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-apple-subtext hover:text-black hover:bg-black/5'}`}
          >
            Ô£é´©Å Barbeiro
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => switchRole('recepcao')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all ${currentUser.role === 'recepcao' && currentView === 'panel' ? 'bg-black text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-apple-subtext hover:text-black hover:bg-black/5'}`}
          >
            ­ƒôï Recep├º├úo
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => switchRole('cliente')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all ${currentUser.role === 'cliente' && currentView === 'panel' ? 'bg-black text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-apple-subtext hover:text-black hover:bg-black/5'}`}
          >
            ­ƒæñ Cliente VIP
          </button>
          <div className="h-4 w-[1px] bg-gray-200 mx-1"></div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setCurrentView(currentView === 'site' ? 'panel' : 'site')}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-[#C9A356] hover:bg-[#B59044] text-black transition-all shadow-sm"
          >
            {currentView === 'site' ? 'Abrir Painel ÔåÆ' : 'Ver Site P├║blico'}
          </button>
        </div>
      );

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F5F5F7] text-[#1D1D1F] flex flex-col antialiased">
          
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* MODO 1: SITE P├ÜBLICO (APPLE MINIMALIST & EDITORIAL DESIGN)               */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {currentView === 'site' && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-white">
              
              {/* TOPBAR ULTRA CLEAN APPLE */}
              <nav className="sticky top-0 z-40 glass-apple border-b border-apple-border/70 px-6 py-3.5 transition-all">
                <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => { setCurrentView('site'); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }}>
                    <OfficialLogo className="w-10 h-10" />
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-serif font-bold text-lg tracking-wider text-[#1D1D1F] block leading-none">VALVERD'S</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-serif tracking-[0.25em] text-[#C9A356] uppercase font-bold">BarberShop</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 text-xs font-medium text-apple-subtext">
                    <a href="#sobre" className="hover:text-black transition-colors">Sobre</a>
                    <a href="#espaco" className="hover:text-black transition-colors">Espa├ºo</a>
                    <a href="#servicos" className="hover:text-black transition-colors">Servi├ºos</a>
                    <a href="#bar" className="hover:text-black transition-colors">Bar & Bebidas</a>
                    <a href="#equipe" className="hover:text-black transition-colors">Equipe</a>
                    <a href="#localizacao" className="hover:text-black transition-colors">Localiza├º├úo</a>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => switchRole('cliente')}
                      className="text-xs font-medium text-apple-text hover:text-black px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 transition-all"
                    >
                      ├ürea do Cliente
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => switchRole('dono')}
                      className="text-xs font-semibold bg-black hover:bg-[#1D1D1F] text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-full transition-all shadow-sm"
                    >
                      Acesso Gerencial
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </nav>

              {/* HERO SECTION APPLE-STYLE */}
              <section className="relative overflow-hidden pt-16 pb-24 px-6 md:px-12 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#FAF9F6] to-white border-b border-apple-border/50">
                <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto text-center space-y-6">
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#C9A356]/10 border border-[#C9A356]/30 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium text-[#A68238]">
                    <span>­ƒôì R. Ant├┤nio Veloso J├║nior, 77 ÔÇó Campos El├¡seos ÔÇó Resende / RJ</span>
                  </div>

                  <h1 className="font-serif text-4xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1D1D1F] uppercase">
                    Valverd's BarberShop
                  </h1>

                  <p className="font-serif italic text-lg sm:text-2xl text-[#C9A356] tracking-widest font-normal">
                    "Beard, hair and mustache"
                  </p>

                  <p className="max-w-2xl mx-auto text-sm sm:text-base text-apple-subtext leading-relaxed font-normal">
                    Experi├¬ncia de barbearia cl├íssica com precis├úo contempor├ónea. Atendimento com hor├írio marcado, ambiente climatizado, toalhas quentes e bar cortesia.
                  </p>

                  <div className="pt-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-center items-center gap-3">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => { setBookingForm(prev => ({ ...prev, serviceId: 's1', barberKey: 'luis' })); setIsBookingModalOpen(true); }}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-3.5 bg-[#C9A356] hover:bg-[#B59044] text-black font-semibold text-sm rounded-full transition-all shadow-apple hover:shadow-apple-hover"
                    >
                      Agendar Hor├írio ÔÇó A Partir de R$ 40
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => switchRole('cliente')}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3.5 bg-white border border-apple-border hover:bg-apple-bg text-[#1D1D1F] font-semibold text-sm rounded-full transition-all shadow-sm"
                    >
                      ­ƒæñ Meu Cart├úo Fidelidade
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* SLIDER / FOTO DESTAQUE */}
                <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto mt-14">
                  <div className="relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-apple-lg border border-apple-border bg-black aspect-[16/9] sm:aspect-[21/9]">
                    <img
                      src={GALLERY_SLIDES[currentSlide].url}
                      alt={GALLERY_SLIDES[currentSlide].caption}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-all duration-700"
                    />
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-transparent to-transparent flex justify-between items-end p-6 text-white">
                      <p className="font-serif text-sm sm:text-base">{GALLERY_SLIDES[currentSlide].caption}</p>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <button onClick={prevSlide} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full glass-dark hover:bg-white hover:text-black flex items-center justify-center transition-all">
                          <Icon.ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                        <button onClick={nextSlide} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full glass-dark hover:bg-white hover:text-black flex items-center justify-center transition-all">
                          <Icon.ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

              {/* PILARES APPLE CARDS */}
              <section className="py-20 px-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
                <div className="text-center mb-12">
                  <span className="text-xs font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Nossos Pilares</span>
                  <h2 className="font-serif text-3xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F] mt-1">Por que escolher a Valverd's</h2>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
                  {BRAND_PILLARS.map((p, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="bg-[#F5F5F7] p-8 rounded-3xl border border-transparent hover:border-apple-border hover:bg-white transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-apple">
                      <div className="text-3xl mb-4">{p.icon}</div>
                      <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-[#1D1D1F] mb-2">{p.title}</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-apple-subtext leading-relaxed">{p.desc}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>

              {/* SERVI├çOS EM CARDS APPLE CLEAN */}
              <section id="servicos" className="py-20 px-6 bg-[#FAF9F6] border-y border-apple-border/60">
                <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto">
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-end mb-12">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Tabela Oficial</span>
                      <h2 className="font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F] mt-1">Servi├ºos & Experi├¬ncia</h2>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-apple-subtext mt-2 sm:mt-0">Todos os servi├ºos incluem toalha aquecida e caf├® espresso cortesia.</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                    {services.map((srv) => (
                      <div key={srv.id} className="bg-white p-7 rounded-3xl border border-apple-border shadow-apple flex flex-col justify-between hover:shadow-apple-hover transition-all group">
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase tracking-wider text-[#C9A356] font-bold bg-[#FAF8F2] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-[#C9A356]/20">
                              {srv.category}
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-serif font-bold text-2xl text-[#1D1D1F]">
                              R$ {srv.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-[#1D1D1F] group-hover:text-[#C9A356] transition-colors">{srv.name}</h3>
                          <p className="text-xs text-apple-subtext leading-relaxed mt-2">{srv.description}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-apple-border/60 flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-xs text-apple-subtext flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Icon.Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-apple-subtext" /> {srv.duration} min
                          </span>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => { setBookingForm(prev => ({ ...prev, serviceId: srv.id })); setIsBookingModalOpen(true); }}
                            className="px-4 py-2 bg-black hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-white hover:text-black text-xs font-semibold rounded-full transition-all"
                          >
                            Agendar
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

              <section id="bar" className="py-20 px-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto">

                  <span className="text-xs font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Bar & Lounge</span>
                  <h2 className="font-serif text-3xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F] mt-1">Cervejas Especiais & Cortesias</h2>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 items-center">
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    {products.filter(p => p.category === 'Bar').map(b => (
                      <div key={b.id} className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-apple-border shadow-sm flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                        <div>
                          <strong className="text-sm font-serif font-bold text-[#1D1D1F] block">{b.name}</strong>
                          <span className="text-apple-subtext">{b.type}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className={`font-serif font-bold text-sm ${b.price === 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full' : 'text-[#C9A356]'}`}>
                          {b.price === 0 ? 'Cortesia' : `R$ ${b.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-apple-border shadow-apple-lg aspect-[4/3]">
                    <img src="espaco_interior_2.png" alt="Lounge Valverd's" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

              {/* EQUIPE */}
              <section id="equipe" className="py-20 px-6 bg-[#FAF9F6] border-t border-apple-border/60">
                <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
                  <div className="text-center mb-12">
                    <span className="text-xs font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Profissionais</span>
                    <h2 className="font-serif text-3xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F] mt-1">Mestres da Navalha</h2>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                    {barbers.map(b => (

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">

                            <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-xl text-[#1D1D1F]">{b.name}</h3>
                            <span className="text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium">{b.handle}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-apple-subtext leading-relaxed mb-4">{b.bio}</p>
                        <div className="bg-[#F5F5F7] p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] mb-4">
                          <strong>Especialidades:</strong> {b.specialties}
                        </div>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => { setBookingForm(prev => ({ ...prev, barberKey: b.barberKey })); setIsBookingModalOpen(true); }}
                          className="w-full py-2.5 bg-black hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-white hover:text-black text-xs font-semibold rounded-full transition-all"
                        >

              <section id="localizacao" className="py-20 px-6 bg-white border-t border-apple-border/60">
                <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-10 items-center">
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <span className="text-xs font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Campos El├¡seos</span>
                    <h2 className="font-serif text-3xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Venha Nos Visitar</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-apple-subtext leading-relaxed">
                      Estamos localizados no cora├º├úo de Campos El├¡seos em Resende / RJ. Espa├ºo climatizado com Wi-Fi, caf├® gourmet e estacionamento na rua.
                    </p>
                    <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 text-xs">
                      <div className="p-4 bg-[#F5F5F7] rounded-2xl border border-apple-border/60">
                        <strong className="block text-[#1D1D1F] mb-0.5">Endere├ºo Oficial:</strong>
                        <span className="text-apple-subtext">{ADDRESS_FULL}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="p-4 bg-[#F5F5F7] rounded-2xl border border-apple-border/60">
                        <strong className="block text-[#1D1D1F] mb-0.5">Hor├írio de Atendimento:</strong>
                        <span className="text-apple-subtext">Segunda a S├íbado: 09:00 ├ás 19:00 (Domingo Fechado)</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="p-4 bg-[#F5F5F7] rounded-2xl border border-apple-border/60">
                        <strong className="block text-[#1D1D1F] mb-0.5">WhatsApp / Agendamento Direto:</strong>
                        <span className="text-apple-subtext">(21) 97010-0668</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-apple-border shadow-apple-lg p-2 bg-[#F5F5F7]">
                    <a href={GOOGLE_MAPS_LINK} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="block group">
                      <img src="espaco_real_maps.png" alt="Google Maps Valverd's" className="w-full rounded-2xl object-cover group-hover:opacity-95 transition-opacity" />

                              onClick={() => setBarberCalendarMode('mensal')}

                            >

                              disabled={selectedWeekIndex === WEEKS_DATA.length - 1}

                            </button>

                        {barberCalendarMode === 'semanal' && (

                            <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-3">
                              {currentWeek.days.map((d) => {
                                const dayAppts = myAllAppointments.filter(a => a.day === d.name && (a.weekId === currentWeek.id || (currentWeek.id === 0 && a.weekId === undefined)));
                                const isSelected = selectedWeekDay === d.name;
                                return (

                            {/* LISTA EDIT├üVEL DE AGENDAMENTOS DO DIA */}

                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                      <div className="w-16 text-center py-2 bg-white rounded-xl border border-apple-border shadow-sm">

                                      </div>
                                      <div>
                                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                          <strong className="text-sm font-serif font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">{a.client}</strong>

                                      {/* BOT├òES DE CONTROLE DE FLUXO */}
                                      {a.status === 'agendado' && (
                                        <button
                                          onClick={() => changeAppointmentStatus(a.id, 'aguardando')}
                                          className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-apple-border hover:bg-black/5 text-[#1D1D1F] rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all"
                                        >
                                          ­ƒøï´©Å Chegou
                                        </button>

                                      {a.status === 'aguardando' && (
                                        <button
                                          onClick={() => changeAppointmentStatus(a.id, 'em_atendimento')}
                                          className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all"
                                        >
                                          Ô£é´©Å Na Cadeira
                                        </button>
                                      )}
                                      {a.status === 'em_atendimento' && (
                                        <button
                                          onClick={() => openCheckout(a)}

                                        <Icon.Edit className="w-4 h-4" />

                                        <Icon.Trash className="w-4 h-4" />

                                {myAllAppointments.filter(a => a.day === selectedWeekDay && (a.weekId === currentWeek.id || (currentWeek.id === 0 && a.weekId === undefined))).length === 0 && (

                        {/* MODO MENSAL (SETEMBRO 2026) */}

'bg-black text-white border-black shadow-md' : d.isOpen ? 'bg-[#F5F5F7] text-[#1D1D1F] border-apple-border hover:border-black/30' : 'bg-transparent text-gray-400 border-transparent cursor-default'}`}

                                      {d.isOpen ? (

                                  </button>
                                );
                              })}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* MODO COMPARATIVO DE CADEIRAS (LUIS VS YAGO) */}
                        {barberCalendarMode === 'comparativo' && (
                          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-apple-border shadow-apple p-6 space-y-4">
                            <div>
                              <h3 className="font-serif text-lg font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Grade Comparativa por Cadeira ({selectedWeekDay})</h3>

                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-2 border-b border-apple-border/60">
                            <span className="text-apple-subtext">Barbeiro de Confian├ºa:</span>
                            <strong className="font-serif font-bold text-[#C9A356]">{clientProfile.preferredBarber}</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-2 border-b border-apple-border/60">
                            <span className="text-apple-subtext">Servi├ºo Mais Pedido:</span>
                            <strong className="text-[#1D1D1F]">{clientProfile.preferredService}</strong>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <span className="text-apple-subtext block mb-1.5">Anota├º├Áes do seu Corte:</span>
                            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-xl border border-apple-border text-[#1D1D1F] font-medium leading-relaxed">
                              "{clientProfile.styleNotes}"
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <button
                          onClick={() => { setBookingForm(prev => ({ ...prev, barberKey: 'luis', serviceId: 's1' })); setIsBookingModalOpen(true); }}
                          className="w-full py-3.5 bg-[#C9A356] hover:bg-[#B59044] text-black font-semibold text-xs rounded-full transition-all shadow-sm uppercase tracking-wider"
                        >
                          ÔÜí Repetir Meu ├Ültimo Corte com Luis Valverde
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}

                  </div>
                )}

              </main>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* MODAL: NOVO AGENDAMENTO / ENCAIXE (APPLE SHEET)                          */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {isBookingModalOpen && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-apple-border max-w-lg w-full p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-apple-lg space-y-5">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start pb-3 border-b border-apple-border">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Agendamento & Encaixe</span>
                    <h3 className="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Marcar Hor├írio</h3>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={() => setIsBookingModalOpen(false)} className="text-apple-subtext hover:text-black text-xl font-bold p-1">
                    Ô£ò
                  </button>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={handleCreateBooking} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-medium text-apple-subtext mb-1">Nome do Cliente:</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        required
                        value={bookingForm.client}
                        onChange={e => setBookingForm({ ...bookingForm, client: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="Ex: Carlos Eduardo"
                        className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#C9A356]"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-medium text-apple-subtext mb-1">WhatsApp:</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        required
                        value={bookingForm.phone}
                        onChange={e => setBookingForm({ ...bookingForm, phone: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="(21) 98888-7777"
                        className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#C9A356]"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-medium text-apple-subtext mb-1">Servi├ºo:</label>
                    <select
                      value={bookingForm.serviceId}
                      onChange={e => setBookingForm({ ...bookingForm, serviceId: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] focus:outline-none"
                    >
                      {services.map(s => (
                        <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name} ÔÇö R$ {s.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-medium text-apple-subtext mb-1">Barbeiro:</label>
                      <select
                        value={bookingForm.barberKey}
                        onChange={e => setBookingForm({ ...bookingForm, barberKey: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] focus:outline-none"
                      >
                        {barbers.map(b => (
                          <option key={b.id} value={b.barberKey}>{b.name.split(' ')[0]}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-medium text-apple-subtext mb-1">Dia:</label>
                      <select
                        value={bookingForm.day}
                        onChange={e => setBookingForm({ ...bookingForm, day: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] focus:outline-none"
                      >
                        <option value="Seg">Segunda (08/09)</option>
                        <option value="Ter">Ter├ºa (09/09)</option>
                        <option value="Qua">Quarta (10/09)</option>
                        <option value="Qui">Quinta (11/09)</option>
                        <option value="Sex">Sexta (12/09)</option>
                        <option value="S├íb">S├íbado (13/09)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-medium text-apple-subtext mb-1">Hor├írio:</label>
                      <select
                        value={bookingForm.time}
                        onChange={e => setBookingForm({ ...bookingForm, time: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] focus:outline-none"
                      >
                        {TIME_SLOTS_COMPARE.map(t => (
                          <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-medium text-apple-subtext mb-1">Observa├º├Áes do Corte / Prefer├¬ncia:</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={bookingForm.notes}
                      onChange={e => setBookingForm({ ...bookingForm, notes: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="Ex: Degrad├¬ cl├íssico na tesoura, toalha quente..."
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs text-[#1D1D1F] focus:outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-3 flex gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsBookingModalOpen(false)}
                      className="flex-1 py-3 bg-[#F5F5F7] hover:bg-apple-border text-[#1D1D1F] font-semibold rounded-full transition-all"
                    >
                      Cancelar
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="flex-1 py-3 bg-black hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-white hover:text-black font-semibold rounded-full transition-all shadow-sm"
                    >
                      Confirmar Agendamento
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* MODAL: EDITAR AGENDAMENTO (EDI├ç├âO DIRETA)                                 */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {isEditApptModalOpen && editingAppt && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-apple-border max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-apple-lg space-y-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start pb-3 border-b border-apple-border">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Gerenciamento</span>
                    <h3 className="font-serif text-xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Editar Agendamento</h3>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={() => setIsEditApptModalOpen(false)} className="text-apple-subtext hover:text-black text-xl font-bold">Ô£ò</button>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={handleSaveEditedAppt} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Cliente:</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={editingAppt.client}
                      onChange={e => setEditingAppt({ ...editingAppt, client: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Hor├írio:</label>
                      <select
                        value={editingAppt.time}
                        onChange={e => setEditingAppt({ ...editingAppt, time: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs"
                      >
                        {TIME_SLOTS_COMPARE.map(t => <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Status:</label>
                      <select
                        value={editingAppt.status}
                        onChange={e => setEditingAppt({ ...editingAppt, status: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold"
                      >
                        <option value="agendado">Agendado</option>
                        <option value="aguardando">No Lounge</option>
                        <option value="em_atendimento">Na Cadeira</option>
                        <option value="concluido">Conclu├¡do</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Observa├º├Áes:</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={editingAppt.notes}
                      onChange={e => setEditingAppt({ ...editingAppt, notes: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 flex gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsEditApptModalOpen(false)}
                      className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-[#F5F5F7] text-[#1D1D1F] font-semibold rounded-full"
                    >
                      Cancelar
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-black hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-white hover:text-black font-semibold rounded-full transition-all"
                    >
                      Salvar Altera├º├Áes
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* MODAL: FECHAMENTO DE COMANDA / CHECKOUT                                   */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {isCheckoutModalOpen && checkoutAppt && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-apple-border max-w-lg w-full p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-apple-lg space-y-5">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start pb-3 border-b border-apple-border">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Caixa & Checkout</span>
                    <h3 className="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Fechar Comanda</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-apple-subtext">{checkoutAppt.client} ÔÇö {checkoutAppt.service}</p>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={() => setIsCheckoutModalOpen(false)} className="text-apple-subtext hover:text-black text-xl font-bold">Ô£ò</button>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div className="bg-[#F5F5F7] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-apple-border/70 space-y-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-apple-subtext uppercase tracking-wider block text-[10px]">Itens Consumidos:</span>
                    {checkoutAppt.items.map((item, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-apple-border/40 last:border-none">
                        <span className="font-medium text-[#1D1D1F]">{item.name}</span>
                        <strong className="font-serif text-[#C9A356]">R$ {item.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</strong>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1 font-medium">+ Adicionar Bebida ou Pomada ├á Comanda:</label>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <select
                        value={additionalItemId}
                        onChange={e => setAdditionalItemId(e.target.value)}
                        className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs"
                      >
                        <option value="">Selecione um item do bar ou produto...</option>
                        {products.filter(p => p.stock > 0).map(p => (
                          <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name} ÔÇö R$ {p.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          const prod = products.find(p => p.id === additionalItemId);
                          addItemToCheckout(prod);
                        }}
                        className="px-4 py-2 bg-black hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-white hover:text-black font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all"
                      >
                        Adicionar
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200/60 flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-bold text-emerald-900 text-sm">Total da Comanda:</span>
                    <strong className="font-serif text-3xl font-bold text-emerald-600">
                      R$ {checkoutAppt.total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                    </strong>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1 font-medium">Forma de Pagamento:</label>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                      {['PIX', 'CART├âO', 'DINHEIRO'].map(m => (
                        <button
                          key={m}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setSelectedPayment(m)}
                          className={`py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs transition-all ${selectedPayment === m ? 'bg-black text-white shadow-sm' : 'bg-[#F5F5F7] text-[#1D1D1F] border border-apple-border'}`}
                        >
                          {m}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 flex gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsCheckoutModalOpen(false)}
                      className="flex-1 py-3 bg-[#F5F5F7] text-[#1D1D1F] font-semibold rounded-full"
                    >
                      Cancelar
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleConfirmCheckout}
                      className="flex-1 py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-full shadow-sm"
                    >
                      Confirmar Pagamento
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* MODAL: VENDA R├üPIDA DE BALC├âO                                             */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {isQuickSaleModalOpen && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-apple-border max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-apple-lg space-y-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start pb-3 border-b border-apple-border">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">PDV Balc├úo</span>
                    <h3 className="font-serif text-xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Venda Avulsa</h3>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={() => setIsQuickSaleModalOpen(false)} className="text-apple-subtext hover:text-black text-xl font-bold">Ô£ò</button>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={handleQuickSale} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Produto / Bebida:</label>
                    <select
                      value={quickSaleProduct ? quickSaleProduct.id : ''}
                      onChange={e => setQuickSaleProduct(products.find(p => p.id === e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs font-medium"
                    >
                      {products.map(p => (
                        <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name} ÔÇö R$ {p.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} ({p.stock} un)</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Quantidade:</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        max={quickSaleProduct ? quickSaleProduct.stock : 10}
                        value={quickSaleQty}
                        onChange={e => setQuickSaleQty(parseInt(e.target.value) || 1)}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Pagamento:</label>
                      <select
                        value={quickSalePayment}
                        onChange={e => setQuickSalePayment(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold"
                      >
                        <option value="PIX">PIX</option>
                        <option value="CART├âO">CART├âO</option>
                        <option value="DINHEIRO">DINHEIRO</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="p-4 bg-[#F5F5F7] rounded-2xl flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Total a Receber:</span>
                    <strong className="font-serif text-2xl text-emerald-600">
                      R$ {((quickSaleProduct ? quickSaleProduct.price : 0) * quickSaleQty).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                    </strong>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 flex gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsQuickSaleModalOpen(false)}
                      className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-[#F5F5F7] text-[#1D1D1F] font-semibold rounded-full"
                    >
                      Cancelar
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-black hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-white hover:text-black font-semibold rounded-full transition-all"
                    >
                      Finalizar Venda
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* MODAL: NOVO PRODUTO NO ESTOQUE                                            */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {isNewProductModalOpen && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-apple-border max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-apple-lg space-y-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start pb-3 border-b border-apple-border">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Invent├írio</span>
                    <h3 className="font-serif text-xl font-bold text-[#1D1D1F]">Cadastrar Produto</h3>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={() => setIsNewProductModalOpen(false)} className="text-apple-subtext hover:text-black text-xl font-bold">Ô£ò</button>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={handleAddNewProduct} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Nome do Produto:</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={newProductForm.name}
                      onChange={e => setNewProductForm({ ...newProductForm, name: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="Ex: Cerveja Stella Artois (330ml)"
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Categoria:</label>
                      <select
                        value={newProductForm.category}
                        onChange={e => setNewProductForm({ ...newProductForm, category: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs"
                      >
                        <option value="Bar">Bar</option>
                        <option value="Produtos">Produtos</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Pre├ºo de Venda (R$):</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="0.50"
                        required
                        value={newProductForm.price}
                        onChange={e => setNewProductForm({ ...newProductForm, price: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Estoque Inicial:</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        value={newProductForm.stock}
                        onChange={e => setNewProductForm({ ...newProductForm, stock: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-apple-subtext mb-1">Estoque M├¡nimo:</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        value={newProductForm.minStock}
                        onChange={e => setNewProductForm({ ...newProductForm, minStock: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-apple-border rounded-xl text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 flex gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsNewProductModalOpen(false)}
                      className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-[#F5F5F7] text-[#1D1D1F] font-semibold rounded-full"
                    >
                      Cancelar
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-black hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-white hover:text-black font-semibold rounded-full transition-all"
                    >
                      Salvar no Estoque
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* DOCK FLUTUANTE DE DEMO APPLE */}
          <FloatingDemoSwitcher />

        </div>
      );
    }

    const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));
    root.render(<ValverdsApp />);
  </script>

</body></html>
